大理市区或高铁剑川/鹤庆站自驾/商务专车 1.5 小时进剑川山坝: Self-drive or business private car from Dali urban area or Jianchuan/Heqing high-speed railway station for 1.5 hours into Jianchuan mountain basin
大运会同款交子双塔晚霞炫丽、大熊猫清早吹冰块极萌: Universiade same-style Jiaozhi Twin Towers dazzling sunset glow, pandas blowing ice cubes in the morning are extremely cute
大雪覆满布宫白阶红宫顶、八廓街煨桑白烟穿雪: Heavy snow covers the white steps and red palace roofs of the Potala Palace, white smoke from sang offerings in Barkhor Street pierces through the snow
大风大雨冲散盆地浮尘后的次日破晓晴天: Dawn clear sky on the day after strong winds and heavy rain wash away the basin's floating dust
大风干寒、偶有雪阻高垭口: Strong cold winds, occasionally snow-blocked high mountain passes
天无三日晴的真仙气：瀑布水量狂翻倍、鼓楼生白云: The true immortal atmosphere of skies with rarely three consecutive sunny days: waterfall water volume surges multiple times, white clouds rise from the drum tower
天星桥最绝美的不是上半段人造数生步，是走到下半段无人去的“天星洞”与如万条细白银: The most stunning part of Tianxingqiao is not the artificial steps of numbering life in the upper section, but the untraveled 'Tianxing Cave' in the lower section and the 'Silver Chain Descending Pond Waterfall' where ten thousand fine white silver threads plunge into the sinkhole pool; do not turn back halfway! Must wear a raincoat when entering the water curtain cave to avoid getting completely soaked.
天气温暖晴日多: Warm weather and many sunny days
天清万里！十里杨林金秋全盛: Clear skies for ten thousand miles! Full autumn splendor of the ten-li poplar forest
天蓝水澄、全年最绝金秋王炸月: Blue skies and clear water, the year's most stunning golden autumn blockbuster month
天际线尽头凭空立起一排排金红色巨型雪山剑峰（大雪塘、四姑娘山幺妹峰甚至贡嘎东坡）: Rows of golden-red giant snow mountain sword peaks (Dashenghuo, Four Girls Mountain Yaomei Peak, and even Gongga East Slope) spontaneously rise at the end of the skyline against the silhouette of modern skyscrapers, hailed as the Earth's mega-city geological romantic wonder #1.
天青云淡、满城金黄白杨映衬红白宫殿: Clear skies and light clouds, city-wide golden aspens set against red and white palaces
天青少雾、万山五彩巅峰: Clear skies, few mists, peaks in their multicolored prime
太阳宫预约下午茶就能进去参观那绝美的建筑礁石艺术空间；环海东路驾敞篷或小电车追“: Make an afternoon tea reservation at the Sun Palace to tour that stunning architectural reef art space; driving a convertible or small electric scooter along Erhai East Road to chase the 'Cangshan sunset purple clouds and crepuscular rays' is an absolute god-tier enjoyment!
奔赴铜仁梵净山 · 爬天空之城双寺庙收官: Head to Tongren Fanjishan · Climb the City in the Sky twin temples to wrap up
好太阳让小七孔翠绿水色呈现最耀眼的半透明蒂芙尼果冻感，日光斜打黄果树暴飞出的水雾: Good sunshine makes Xiaoshiqi's emerald water color present the most dazzling semi-transparent Tiffany jelly feel, sunlight striking the water mist blasted by Huangguoshu instantly reveals a huge, gorgeous, colorful arc-shaped double rainbow!
如果幸逢夕阳穿透暴风雨云，古格与冈仁波齐火烧云紫到极致！: If you are fortunate enough to encounter sunset piercing through thunderstorm clouds, Guge and Mount Kailash fire clouds turn intensely purple!
妥乐村千株古老银杏落叶满水桥、贵阳街道红叶梧桐秋意深: Thousands of ancient ginkgo trees shedding leaves over the water bridge in Tuole Village, red-leafed phoenix trees in Guiyang streets with deep autumn vibes
始建于唐代南诏国的 69 米高方形密檐空心千寻大砖塔携两座小塔挺立于苍山中和峰东: Built in the Tang Dynasty Nanzhao Kingdom, the 69-meter-high square multi-eaved hollow Qianxun Big Brick Pagoda, alongside two smaller pagodas, stands proudly on the eastern slope of Cangshan's Zhonghe Peak. Having survived over a dozen strong earthquakes for a thousand years without falling, its 'Eternal Suppression of Mountains and Rivers' bearing is magnificent.
季风撤离！9月下旬全年最无瑕蓝天开启: Monsoon retreats! The most flawless blue sky of the year begins in late September
学生散去人锐减、秋高水色犹清且渐金: Students leave and crowds drop sharply, autumn water remains clear and gradually turns golden
安顺黄果树 · 钻入水帘洞心感受澎湃瀑雨: Anshun Huangguoshu · Dive into the Water Curtain Cave to experience the surging waterfall rain
宗角禄康紧依布达拉宫正后方；南山公园位于拉萨河南岸打车仅 10 分钟（均免门票）: Zongjolukang closely adjoins the exact rear of the Potala Palace; Nanshan Park is located on the south bank of the Lhasa River, only a 10-minute taxi ride (both admission-free)
宽达 270 米的钙华悬崖大瀑布“诺日朗”飞花碎玉（冬日全部冻为百米壮观蓝冰帘）: The 270-meter-wide travertine cliff waterfall 'Norilang' scatters flowers like jade (in winter, completely frozen into hundred-meter spectacular blue ice curtains); downstream, a 2.2-kilometer stretch of Shuzheng Lakes and golden reed marshes weaves out a 'jade belt river' shining bright blue and green.
寒风小雨里泡火山硫磺泉 + 热带太阳雨现双彩虹: Soak in volcanic sulfur springs in cold wind and light rain + tropical sun showers revealing double rainbows
小中甸成片粉红狼毒与黄杜鹃花海，草原青绿无比: Xiaozhongdian patches of pink toxicodendron and yellow azalea flower seas, grasslands are exceptionally green and lush
小雨会让大研古城变得非常诗意柔和，找一间临小桥流水的纳西四合院点黑山羊汤锅或腊排: Light rain makes Dayan Ancient Town extremely poetic and soft; find a Naxi courtyard by the stream to order black goat hot pot or cured spareribs and listen to the rain sound to cure the blues; after rain, Lugu Lake often produces a massive, breathtaking double rainbow spanning directly across the peninsula.
小雨使湖面呈现柔润缎面质感（且减少水面强光刺斑），周围红桦落叶松湿润后颜色更为浓: Light rain gives the lake surface a soft satin texture (and reduces strong water surface glare spots), surrounding red birch and larch colors become richer and more mellow after getting damp, only with fewer highlight spots, completely without harming the fairy-like atmosphere!
小雨让四姑娘山常现雪冠探出滚滚白海的神秘仙山姿容；巴朗山盘山公路更有 80% 概: Light rain makes Four Girls Mountain often reveal the mysterious immortal mountain posture of snow-capped peaks protruding from rolling white seas of clouds; Balang Mountain winding road has an 80% probability of breaking through dense clouds above the cloud surface to watch the sunrise over the sea of clouds!
小雨转停一刹全红河谷生出遮山平流白玉带: The moment light rain stops, the entire Red River Valley gives birth to a mountain-blocking flat-lying white jade belt
山下菜花开山顶残雪: Rapeseed flowers blooming at the foot of the mountain with residual snow on the summit
山口处海拔已高达近五千米，风极大极冷切勿激动作剧烈蹦跳；日托寺单程距羊湖景区首站: The altitude at the mountain pass is already close to 5,000 meters, winds are extremely strong and cold, do not act excitedly or jump vigorously; Litu-ji Temple is still about 1.5 hours of unpaved asphalt driving from the first stop of the Yamdrok Lake scenic area, but standing on the rooftop of the 'world's most isolated temple' surrounded entirely by translucent blue lake water makes the extra driving totally worth it!
山城春夜凉风极舒服！武隆天坑洞内飞瀑水充沛绿茸茸: Mountain city spring nights feature extremely comfortable cool breezes! Wulong Three Natural Bridges caves feature abundant cascading waterfalls and lush green moss
山脊摩托与风味餐: Ridge motorcycle and local flavor dining
山脚开春而雪山厚积不融，极少人潮低价游神山: Spring flowers blooming at the mountain base while snow mountains remain thickly accumulated and unmelted, low crowds and low-cost tour of the sacred mountain
山脚鲜花与绿叶四季如春穿着薄衬衫，抬头便是苍山百里雪冠白头连绵不绝，形成极为奢侈: Flowers and green leaves at the mountain base are spring-like year-round allowing light shirts, while looking up reveals Cangshan's hundred-mile continuous snow-capped white peaks, creating an extremely luxurious urban visual climate.
山腰自购防滑冰爪、羽绒大衣、防冻鞋。: Purchase anti-slip crampons, down parkas, and freeze-proof shoes halfway up the mountain.
山路湿冷备抓绒外防雨外壳、防滑防水胶鞋、便携三脚架。: Mountain roads are wet and cold, pack fleece outer rain shells, anti-slip waterproof rubber shoes, and a portable tripod.
山野碧翠、雨水洗透蓝天偶见极猛烈双彩虹跨神山: Mountain wilderness is emerald green, rain washes the blue sky clean, occasionally witnessing extremely fierce double rainbows spanning across the sacred mountain
山顶银装素裹打雪仗，进城九宫格毛肚老火锅过圣诞: Silver-clad mountains and snowball fights at the summit; a 9x9 grid spicy beef tallow hot pot in the city to celebrate Christmas
岷江水澎湃壮丽、南桥蓝眼泪夜景氛围凉爽爆棚: Magnificent and surging Minjiang River waters; cool and breathtaking night view of the South Bridge Blue Tears
峨眉山南国冰雪世界巅峰！雾凇冰凌映照金普贤，吃滚烫牛肉汤: Peak of Mount Emei's southern winter wonderland! Rime ice and icicles reflecting the Golden Samantabhadra, accompanied by a piping-hot beef soup
峨眉山站换乘景区观光大巴 2 小时抵雷洞坪，步行 1.5 公里接引殿索道直上金顶: Transfer to the scenic area tourist bus at Mount Emei Station for a 2-hour ride to Leidongping, followed by a 1.5 km walk to Jieyinning Cableway straight up to the Golden Summit
峨眉山红珠山宾馆禅意森林私汤温泉别墅1晚 + 金顶大酒店观日出景房1晚: 1 night at Mount Emei Red-Zhu Shan Hotel Zen Forest Private Hot Spring Villa + 1 night at Golden Summit Hotel Sunrise View Room
峨眉山高铁/打车 40 分钟直抵乐山乌尤寺码头乘船或北门徒步上九曲栈道: 40 minutes by high-speed rail/taxi from Mount Emei directly to Leshan Wuyou Temple Wharf to take a boat or hike up the Nine-Bend Plank Road from the North Gate
峨眉门票+金顶往返索道+游船大佛（约450/人）+ 乐山吃撑街头小食: Mount Emei admission + Golden Summit round-trip cableway + Giant Buddha cruise (~480/person) + street food binge in Leshan
崇圣寺/苍山索道或小众徒步 + 酸辣鱼、乳扇、喜洲破酥粑粑、野生菌米线: Chongsheng Temple / Cangshan Cableway or niche hiking + sour and spicy fish, milk fan, Xizhou flaky pastry, wild mushroom rice noodles
崇州重庆路万亩金色油菜花与都江堰樱花海棠春满城: Chongzhou Chongqing Road ten thousand acres of golden rapeseed flowers and Dujiangyan cherry blossom and begonia spring city
巴朗山下来前往四姑娘山镇公路旁免费超大停车观景平台: A free oversized parking viewing platform on the roadside of Siguniangshan Town after descending Balang Mountain
布宫背面宗角禄康小水潭清波中静躺整个布宫倒影、绕湖全是手持转经筒的慈祥阿佳拉；隔: Behind the Potala Palace, the clear waters of the Zongjialukang pond quietly mirror the entire Potala Palace. Circling the lake are kind grandmothers holding prayer wheels. Across the Lhasa River, the small water mirror at South Mountain Park perfectly captures an all-in-one panorama of 'blue skies, white clouds, snow-capped peaks, the giant palace, and their reflection in the water' uniting heaven and earth!
布达拉宫+大昭寺+羊湖+纳木错门票（冬春大片全免极香！）+ 甜茶藏面玛吉阿米藏餐: Potala Palace + Jokhang Temple + Yamdrok Lake + Namtso admission tickets (winter/spring blockbuster freebie, super worth it!) + sweet tea, Tibetan noodles, and Makye Ame Tibetan cuisine hot pot
布达拉宫广场西侧药王山斜对观景台免费开放（进入宫内参观务必提前 7–10 天实名: The viewing platform diagonally opposite Yaowang Mountain on the west side of Potala Palace Square is open for free (advance real-name reservation 7–10 days in advance is essential to visit inside the palace!)
常见半截来福士插进低云里的超科幻“赛博云穿楼”奇景: The hyper-scientific 'cyber cloud piercing the building' spectacle where Raffles City's half-section is plugged into low clouds
干冷大晴日出圣光极佳: Cold, dry, and very sunny with superb holy light at sunrise
干冷大晴雪山王季: Cold, dry, sunny, and the prime season for snow-capped mountains
干晴万丈澄蓝！10月上中旬走阿里大环神月: Dry, sunny, and boundlessly azure! Take the Ali Grand Loop in early-to-mid October
幺妹峰金紫破晓 + 巴朗山顶翻滚落瀑布云: Golden-purple dawn at Sister Peaks + rolling waterfall clouds over the Balang Mountain summit
建于魏晋的千年红墙大慈寺被现代坡顶川西仿古玻璃太古里建筑与裸眼 3D 巨幕楼体拥: The thousand-year-old red walls of Daci Temple, built during the Wei and Jin dynasties, are embraced at the center by modern sloping-roofed Sichuan-style faux-ancient glass architecture and naked-eye 3D giant screen buildings. This creates a magical dialogue across time and space between the ancient temple where Master Xuanzang took his vows and the ultra-luxury modern commercial street.
建议先飞较低海拔林芝（2900m）适应两日再拉萨，回程直飞出藏 + 拉萨往返羊湖: It is recommended to fly first to lower-altitude Nyingchi (2900m) to acclimatize for two days before heading to Lhasa, with a direct flight out of Tibet on the return + official carpooling for Lhasa round trips to Yamdrok Lake and Namtso
弥散供氧四星宿: Four-star accommodation with dispersed oxygen supply
强推 11 月最后两周前往金黄落叶最浓！在院坝树下喝一锅热乎的“银杏炖土鸡”感受: Strongly recommended to visit during the last two weeks of November for the most intense golden fallen leaves! Drink a hot pot of 'ginkgo stewed native chicken' under the courtyard trees and feel time come to a complete standstill.
强推“布达拉峰”那段全直通公路白塔打卡位（有游人道护栏别站路心危险），以及撵鱼坝: Strongly recommended are the straight-through road white pagoda photo spot on the 'Potala Peak' section (stay behind the tourist guardrails, do not stand in the middle of the road as it is dangerous), and the super pleasant forest stream kayaking in Yanyuba during summer and autumn!
强推住金顶一晚守日出日落云海与漫天银河！高海拔昼夜极寒，备冲锋羽绒与氧气瓶防微弱: Strongly recommended to stay at the Golden Summit for a night to catch the sunrise, sunset, sea of clouds, and starry Milky Way! Extreme diurnal temperature drops at high altitudes; pack a shell jacket, down jacket, and oxygen canisters to prevent mild altitude sickness.
强推去鲁朗吃“石锅鸡”一定要在当地吃正宗散养小藏鸡配手掌参野菌！有高反忌在色季拉: Strongly recommended to go to Rulang to eat 'stone pot chicken'—be sure to have authentic free-range small Tibetan chicken paired with palm ginseng and wild mushrooms locally! Those with altitude sickness should avoid running and breathing heavily at Sejigla Pass; snap a few photos and immediately get back in the car down to the forest oxygen-rich Rulang Village!
强推直接住“多依树村”边看日出免凌晨抢车位；早晨山地大雾瞬息万变，绝别在雾起 1: Strongly recommended to stay directly near 'Doi Chu Village' to catch the sunrise without having to scramble for parking spots in the wee hours; morning mountain mists change instantly, so absolutely do not leave just 10 minutes after the fog rises—often after 8 AM the wind suddenly blows away the white veil, bursting open a breathtaking double-layered rainbow mirror!
强推直接斥资住在“索松村一线正面南迦巴瓦的大视野露台酒店”！夜晚看银河直接挂在巨: Strongly recommended to splurge on staying at 'Sosong Village's frontline view terrace hotel facing Namcha Barwa directly'! At night, watch the Milky Way hang directly above the giant pyramid snow peak, and capture the golden-red mountain transformation the second you wake up in bed!
强推预定山巅带地暖星穹帐篷或三角玻璃木屋住一晚，拉开窗帘即收日照金山与脚底无敌流: Strongly recommended to book a hilltop star-dome tent with floor heating or a triangular glass wooden cabin for a night; pull back the curtain to capture the golden mountain at sunrise and invincible flowing clouds beneath your feet.
强烈去“巴松措新措”或鲁朗林海看仙气腾腾满树绿色长胡须松萝原始雨林感！: Strongly recommended to go to 'Basum Tso Xincuo' or Rulang Forest Sea to experience the ethereal, primeval rainforest feel of trees draped in green hanging old-man's-beard lichen!
强烈将贵阳留足一晚专门扫吃：民生路脆哨糯米饭、青岩卤猪脚与玫瑰糖、夺夺粉火锅和冰: Strongly recommended to reserve a full evening in Guiyang exclusively for food hunting: Minsheng Road crispy pork glutinous rice, Qingyan braised pig trotters and rose sugar, duoduofen hot pot, and ice jiang!
强烈尊重寺规！保持绝对静默不喧哗，不随手怼脸偷拍僧尼，仅用门票预约正当进山，绝忌: Strongly recommended to respect temple rules! Maintain absolute silence without making noise, do not casually take close-up stealthy photos of monks and nuns, enter the mountain legitimately using pre-booked tickets, and strictly avoid sneaking in or climbing mountains privately with others.
强烈建议一早在药王山迎晨光拍全景后，下午进南山公园再赏倒影；进布达拉宫严禁拍照穿: Strongly recommended to catch the morning light at Yaowang Mountain for panoramic photos early in the morning, then enter South Mountain Park in the afternoon to enjoy the reflections. Photography, short skirts, hats, and sunglasses are strictly prohibited inside the Potala Palace, and climb the mountain stairs slowly rather than rushing.
强烈建议买扶梯票上最高观景台俯瞰全 S 弯大场景（走木道会爬得缺氧喘大气），多带: Strongly recommended to buy the escalator ticket up to the highest viewing platform to overlook the grand S-curve panorama (walking the wooden trail will cause oxygen-deprived heavy breathing). Bring an extra windproof thick down jacket as the sunset cold wind is extremely freezing!
强烈建议住一晚听侗族大歌无伴奏多声部天然吟唱！再走一段轻便又好看的“堂安—厦格梯: Strongly recommended to stay a night to listen to the Dong ethnic group's a cappella multi-part natural chanting! Then walk a section of the easy and scenic 'Tangan-Xage Terraced Fields downhill ancient stone path' back to the village to enjoy a long-table banquet with sour soup fish!
强烈建议全程电瓶车直接搭到最高站“燕子岩窝”欣赏雪山草原近景再乘电瓶车分站下行游: Strongly recommended to take the battery car directly to the highest station 'Yanziyanwo' to enjoy close-up views of the snow-capped mountains and grasslands, then take the battery car down stop by stop to visit Panyang Lake and Longwang Sea!
强烈建议分两天进亚丁景区（住香格里拉镇）：Day1 下午先走轻松短线冲古寺—珍珠: Strongly recommended to spend two days entering Yading Scenic Area (staying in Shangri-La Town): Day 1 afternoon starts with the easy short route to Chonggu Temple - Pearl Lake; after acclimatizing to 4000m, tackle the long route the next day to Luorong Pasture - Double Lakes!
强烈建议直接在飞来寺住正面向雪山的“既下山梅里”或高楼景观阳台民宿！起床不用出门: Strongly recommended to stay directly at 'Deqia Meili' facing the snow mountains at Feilai Temple or a high-rise view balcony guesthouse! Wake up and sip hot tea wrapped in a quilt watching the golden sunrise on the mountain without even stepping outside!
强烈挑在清晨逛一趟菜市场前早点（大救驾、稀豆粉油条、松花糕极正宗），再去“陷河湿: Strongly recommended to make time in the early morning to visit the morning market for breakfast (Dajiujia, Xidoufen fried dough sticks, and pine flower cakes are extremely authentic), then row a boat among the clear water weeds at 'Xianhe Wetland'.
强烈挑在白沙街口二楼露台喝“7 sea bar”或“合喜”看雪山发呆；晚上想找安: Strongly recommended to spend the morning drinking at the second-floor terrace of '7 sea bar' or 'Hexi' at Baisha Street intersection while daydreaming facing the snow mountains; at night, if you want a quiet watery ambiance, head to the Black Dragon Pool Five-Hole Bridge to shoot the classic architectural masterpiece of the famous 'Jade Dragon Reflection'!
强烈挑清晨 7 点前抵码头的观景弧形水梯！哪怕不坐船只是发呆看这幅油画早晨也足够: Strongly recommended to arrive at the wharf's curved water steps before 7 AM! Even without taking a boat, just daydreaming and watching this oil-painting morning view is enough to savor for the whole year.
强烈推荐“飞来寺住一晚+清晨顺路下到雾浓顶白塔换视角拍大远景”！: Strongly recommended to 'stay a night in Feilai Temple + drop by Wunongding White Pagoda on the way down the next morning to change perspectives for a grand distant view'!
强烈推荐订“大落水或蒗放村”一线面水看日出玻璃阳台酒店（里格半岛内部因保护现多改: Strongly recommended to book a frontline waterfront glass balcony hotel for sunrise views in 'Dalushui or Lufang Village' (Lugu Lake's Lige Peninsula interior has mostly shifted to peripheral viewing due to conservation, and luggage is hard to drag in); take a taxi or chartered car up to the viewing platform in the morning to catch the view!
